attempted_claim: Exact determination: W7* = 3, i.e. the maximum lattice width over hollow lattice 3-polytopes with exactly 7 lattice points is 3, with a complete list of attaining classes given by explicit vertex matrices, a full width-frequency table over H7 for widths 1/2/3, and a certificate that no hollow 7-point polytope has width >= 4 (gap 1); if instead a width>=4 hollow 7-point polytope is found, the headline becomes that first witness with its gap over the previous width-3 record.
claim_type: sharp width maximum with witness-gap certificate
decisive_failure: value: Judging the strongest actually-established headline separately from the admitted W7*=3 target: what is proved is a fragmentary subcensus -- ten hollow width-2 classes across two quasi-minimal branches (8 boxed of 23 listed; 2 spiked of 32 generated), pairwise inequivalent, with the merged branch explicitly unenumerated and W7* left open (2 or 3). This lacks every feature that made the pre-registered target independently retrievable: no sharp maximum, no width-3 (or any) new extremal witness (all ten have width 2, the modal size-7 value; the sole width-3 member q4 is non-hollow), no width-frequency table over H7, no no-width>=4 gap certificate, and no proved spiked-branch structural lemma (only a finite-list width check, in fact =2). The Codenotti-Santos 'consistency' corollary is vacuous (2 < 3.414 constrains nothing and implies nothing for the conjecture). A future researcher needing H7 cannot use or cite this fragment without the dominant merged branch and would simply rerun the seconds-scale filter over the full 496-class census; the ten labels are not known to be needed as a precise standalone fact. Honest scoping to the two lists preserves correctness but leaves a literature-artifact slice (listed/generated quasi-minimal candidates) rather than a natural-object invariant of H7. Certification depth and negative logs do not rescue an arbitrary-scope fragment with no extremal, structural, or census-complete payoff. It falls short even of the pre-registered fallback (boxed+merged subcensus plus width-3 witness plus spiked lemma). Missing substantive result with intrinsically low retrieval value.
